name: Roosevelt County, NM
findings: Roosevelt County has 47 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Roosevelt County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Roosevelt County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
